# Poison resistance mead

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadPoisonResist | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Poison resistance x1 | Duration: 10m | Cooldown: 10m | Other Effect(s): Very resistant vs. Poison

# Introduction

Poison resistance mead is a Black Forest-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Poison resistance.

## Recipe

Mead base: Poison resistance is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Honey
• 5 Thistle
• 1 Neck tail
• 10 Coal
Six Poison resistance meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

## Effect

Upon consumption, it grants "very resistant" to poison damage for 10 minutes, reducing poison effect duration and tick damage by 75%.
The poison resistance only works on poison applied while the resistance is active. A player drinking the mead after they were poisoned will not reduce the effect duration or tick damage.
You typically want to save this for directly before entering combat with a poisonous enemy to get the most time out of the potion. This potion does not last very long so you may want to bring a few per trip.

## Notes

• It is recommended to craft some before entering the Swamp for the first time to counteract the poison effect Other poison-resistant gear requires Roots, which are only obtainable by killing Abominations.
• The Poison resistance mead's "very resistant" effect overrides the "resistant" effect of the Root mask.
• While the Poison resistance mead has a stronger effect than the Root Mask, The Root Mask's buff never expires.
